android.desc:
Pocket Guitar Looper makes it easy to record clean, bar-perfect loops for practice or jamming. 
Set BPM and time signature, choose the number of bars, and record seamless loops with a simple metronome click-in.

Built for acoustic guitar, but works great for voice, violin, flute, bass, or any acoustic instrument.

Features:
• Precount click-in metronome
• Set BPM, time signature, and bars
• Exact-length looping (no drift)
• Save and load your loops (WAV format, upgrade required)
• NEW: Overdubbing Mode. Record unlimited layers to build rich, multi-part arrangements.
• Optional metronome while recording

show_hn.title: Show HN: Android guitar looper app for creating seamless practice loops

quotes.text:
I’m a developer and hobby guitarist, and I built a small Android app to help with practicing.

I always wanted to make a cross-platform native app in C (C99), and this is my attempt.  
I started on macOS and then moved to Android. The hardest parts so far have been JNI integration and handling permissions.  
The GUI is custom and rendered with OpenGL ES.

The app records seamless, bar-perfect loops with a precount click, so you can strum chord changes and improvise over them.

Happy to answer questions or get feedback.
